gaps.why: www.sec.gov returned HTTP 403 for IonQ's Form 8-K on the Oxford Ionics closing (accession 0001193125-25-205489). A Wayback CDX lookup did not return a snapshot. The IonQ press release announces completion and does not state the share or cash consideration.
gaps.would_need: The 8-K or Exhibit 99 body from data.sec.gov, an IR-hosted copy, or a Wayback snapshot that counsel can fetch.

gaps.topic: Honeywell stake in Quantinuum after the 2026 IPO
gaps.why: www.sec.gov returned HTTP 403 for Honeywell's Form 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-06-30 (accession 0000773840-26-000124, filed 2026-07-23 in the data.sec.gov submissions index). Wayback CDX returned no snapshot. This file therefore records the November 2021 majority stake and the nearly $300 million figure, and does not record a 2026 ownership percentage.
gaps.would_need: Honeywell's 10-Q for the period ended 2026-06-30, or Quantinuum's Form 424B4, from a host that accepts the declared User-Agent.

gaps.topic: DOE quantum computing awards to canonical companies
gaps.why: The Department of Energy's 9 September 2024 release of $65 million for quantum computing research names a program total and project count, not IonQ, IBM, Rigetti, Quantinuum, or another canonical hardware company as a recipient.
gaps.would_need: An award table or agency release that names both DOE and the company.

gaps.topic: DARPA US2QC selections of Microsoft and PsiQuantum
gaps.why: DARPA's Stage B page says Microsoft and PsiQuantum entered the final phase of the Underexplored Systems for Utility-Scale Quantum Computing program and that US2QC was expanded into QBI in 2024. The page does not state the selection date or an amount.
gaps.would_need: The DARPA release that announces those selections, with a date.

gaps.topic: Other QBI names not given org records
gaps.why: The Stage B page also names Nord Quantique and Silicon Quantum Computing Pty. Ltd. The Stage A page also names Atlantic Quantum and Hewlett Packard Enterprise. They are outside the canonical company list for this file.
gaps.would_need: A decision to add those orgs, using the same DARPA pages.

gaps.topic: UK testbed winners Cold Quanta UK and Aegiq
gaps.why: The 5 February 2024 UK announcement names Cold Quanta UK (Warwick) and Aegiq (Sheffield). The fetched pages do not identify Cold Quanta UK as Infleqtion. Aegiq is not a canonical company.
gaps.would_need: A primary document that identifies Cold Quanta UK with Infleqtion, if that award is to be recorded under co:infleqtion.

gaps.why: https://www.industry.gov.au/news/leading-quantum-company-chooses-australia-site-its-groundbreaking-utility-scale-quantum-computer timed out with the declared User-Agent. The Prime Minister's 30 April 2024 release was used instead.
gaps.would_need: The Department of Industry release, if counsel wants a second government page.

gaps.why: No Chinese government page was fetched that names both a government body and a canonical company.
gaps.would_need: A government page, fetched in this pass, that names both parties.

gaps.topic: Completed acquisitions of Pasqal, Atom Computing, or PsiQuantum
gaps.why: No primary document fetched in this pass states that one of those companies was acquired or completed an acquisition of another canonical company.
gaps.would_need: A company or SEC filing that states a completed acquisition.

gaps.topic: National awards in Canada, Korea, the Netherlands, and Denmark
gaps.why: No agency release for those countries was fetched. Xanadu's DARPA Stage B selection is a U.S. award. EuroHPC's Italy release mentions quantum computers to be located in Luxembourg and the Netherlands but does not name a vendor for those systems in the sentences used here.
gaps.would_need: An official award or procurement release naming the agency and the company.

gaps.why: EuroHPC's six-site hosting set includes Spain. This file records the signed vendor contracts fetched for Czechia, Germany, Italy, France, and Poland, plus the 2022 HPCQS selection of PASQAL, and does not include a Spain vendor release.
gaps.would_need: The EuroHPC procurement release for the Spain system, if a vendor is named.
